insights: 2,772 streamers share 63,462 mutual follows — density 0.0165: only ~1.65% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 2.431 hops apart (diameter ≥ 7).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 13% of all tie endpoints (max degree 1375 vs median 23).
Partner assortativity = -0.309: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.227: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 7 communities (modularity 0.28); the largest, C1, holds 25% of streamers.
C1 is the most 'professional' community: 18% Partners vs 9% overall.
C3 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (50% vs 39% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
69 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
94 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
